fields.label: Allow Stale Reviews
fields.help: Determines if allow stale reviews or approvals before merging to the branch.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: Determines if the branch rule is disabled or not.

fields.label: Include Pattern
fields.help: The BranchRule matches branches based on the specified regular expression.

fields.label: Minimum Approvals Count
fields.help: The minimum number of approvals required for the branch rule to be matched.

fields.label: Minimum Reviews Count
fields.help: The minimum number of reviews required for the branch rule to be matched.

fields.label: Require Comments Resolved
fields.help: Determines if require comments resolved before merging to the branch.

fields.label: Require Linear History
fields.help: Determines if require linear history before merging to the branch.

fields.label: Require Pull Request
fields.help: Determines if the branch rule requires a pull request or not.
